title: Recombination by Interpolation
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite set of nonzero elements of $F$, and let $f$ assign a field element to each nonzero element of $F$. Recombining the values of $f$ from $A$ equals the value at zero of the polynomial interpolating those values on $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
$f$ is a function from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$
